title: Mad Dogs with Guns: Wargaming in the Gangster Era
author: Howard Whitehouse & Roderick Robertson
publisher: Osprey Games (Osprey Publishing Limited / Bloomsbury Publishing Plc)
acquisition_note: Digital PDF, provided directly by Ross. Library master at G:\My Drive\Wargaming\Mad Dogs with Guns\Mad Dogs with Guns - Wargaming in the Gangster Era.pdf. Working copy extracted from research/sources/mad-dogs-with-guns/original.pdf (gitignored, not committed).
licence_note: Third-party rulebook PDF. Not committed to the repo (research/sources/**/original.pdf is gitignored). source.md quotes/reproduces rules text for research analysis and citation; the vault note itself only quotes what's needed, not a full reproduction.
designer_statement_note: The rulebook is the designers' own primary statement of the rules; the Design Notes chapter (p.105-106) is Howard Whitehouse writing in first person about design intent (card-driven Hold Cards, the campaign/rackets system being mostly Roderick Robertson's contribution, the Paradise setting being his own invention).

extraction_method.reason: Clean embedded text layer confirmed on every page per the pre-read probe (0 replacement characters, median 1519 chars/page, only 7 pages under 120 chars and those are full-page art). Re-verified during extraction: 0 U+FFFD across all 116 pages, 172,624 raw chars extracted.
extraction_method.page_numbering: PDF page index runs 2 ahead of the printed page number from PDF page 5 (printed page 3, Contents) onward. PDF pages 1-4 are cover/half-title/title/copyright with no printed page number. All page citations in the vault note use the printed (footer) page number.
extraction_method.table_verification_note: Rendered printed pages 82 (Official Payoffs) and 102/103 (Rackets of Paradise neighborhood table) at 200dpi and visually confirmed row/column order matches the reconstructed markdown tables in source.md. No reordering found despite the pdftk-java/iText producer chain flagged in the pre-read probe.

capture_contents.source.md: Full 116-page verbatim text capture, page by page (printed page numbers), with 3 of the highest-value data tables reconstructed as clean markdown (Official Payoffs p.82, Wound Severity + Healing p.80, Rackets of Paradise neighborhood table p.102) plus the raw extracted text folded underneath each for audit. Other tabular pages (per-business Loot/Payoff entries, the Skills d66 table) read correctly in row order from the raw extraction without reconstruction.
